admission.justification: Receipts, hook and shared remainder together carry cache deletions through interruption; four proving tests pin replay, remainder, shared recovery and receipt-gated deletion.

applicability: Archive-hook receipt planning, replay, remainder and preview for every deletion class.
conditions: An interrupted or cache-only run replays against a recorded receipt.
exclusions: Deletion classes outside the shared artifact keys.
statement: The new arCaches deletion class is omitted from shared receipt planning, remainder and deleted-name consumers, so an interrupted cache deletion loses its recovery history and an archived dry run can falsely report that nothing would change.
